## What this PR changes

One or two sentences. Link the issue if this is a big change (new lesson, rewrite, new translation language), per the two-tier rule in CONTRIBUTING.md. Small fixes and showcase rows do not need an issue.

## Type

- [ ] Small fix (typo, link, clarification, small code fix)
- [ ] Lesson change (new or rewritten lesson; issue linked above)
- [ ] Translation (language: )
- [ ] Showcase row (my finished capstone)
- [ ] Other

## Checklist

- [ ] If I changed code, I ran it top to bottom in the Lesson 00 setup
- [ ] Any `smoke_test.py` in the lessons I touched passes
- [ ] JSON examples I touched pass `tools/validate_servers.py`
- [ ] The change keeps an offline, zero-credential path (or the lesson flags requirements at the top)
- [ ] No em dashes introduced, and new terms are defined or already in resources/glossary.md
- [ ] If I changed lesson titles or folders, README.md, llms.txt, and PROGRESS.md are updated to match
